Categories.value: Lyngsalpene|Taken with Canon EOS 7D|Images with annotations|Storfjorden (Troms)|Venus Jupiter conjunction in March 2012|Self-published work|Featured pictures by User:Ximonic|Featured night photography|Aurora in Norway|Images with 10+ annotations|Taken under moonlight|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Panoramics in Troms|March in Troms|Featured pictures of landscapes in Norway|Panoramics of the Scandinavian Mountains|Panoramics of fjords in Norway|Panoramas of mountains in Norway|Pictures of the Year/2012 (finalist)|Storfjord by User:Ximonic|Panoramic photographs by User:Ximonic

ImageDescription.value: A wide view over Storfjorden (a part of Lyngen fjord) in a winter night in 2012 March. Some Aurora borealis (known as the northern lights) are running across the sky. The summits lighted by the Moon on the other side of the fjord belong to the Lyngen Alps (Lyngsfjellan). Also the planets Jupiter and Venus are quite near to each other (the bright dots, center left).
